name: Elementor Pro
couldBuild: Pro's additions on top of the free plugin, which already gives you the canvas: custom widgets, a theme-builder location, popup triggers and a form widget.
stillMissing: Theme builder, popup builder, forms, WooCommerce widgets, hundreds of templates, and compatibility with every theme on earth. Scope alone sinks it.
requirements: Theme builder: header, footer, single and archive templates with display conditions
A form widget with validation, actions-after-submit and entry storage
Popup builder with trigger and display rules
A handful of the widgets you actually use, registered against Elementor's widget API
Global colours and fonts propagating across the whole site
notes: Scoped as an add-on, not a rebuild: free Elementor is GPL and supplies the editor, so the MVP is Pro's surface on top of its API. Cut from 50h in v2.51.0 — the old estimate priced rebuilding the canvas, which nobody would do.
